reviewStatus: complete bounded independent review; four accepted-open findings

findings.title: Dirty Runtime additions are not integrated into the canonical root
findings.rationale: The real checker compares fragment and native source hashes and deep-compares current native specifications; the frozen dirty additions differ from the historical canonical root. Parent rerun independently reproduces the same three errors.
findings.requiredAction: Integrate and conserve the Runtime additions, rerun structural controls and obtain independent recheck before claiming current root consistency. Preserve the frozen review inputs and historical checkpoint7 evidence.

findings.title: Historical row digest hashes a modified row, not the preserved original
findings.description: The setdefault call inserts sourceDefinitionHistory=[] before the append argument computes oldRowSHA256. For every one of the 17 amended rows, that digest is therefore over an enriched object rather than the immutable original row in changed-rows-before.json.gz. Exact original snapshots are retained and match checkpoint 21bf; no source data loss was observed. However oldRowSHA256 cannot authenticate the claimed original row and a strict provenance consumer fails.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Compute the canonical old-row digest before inserting/mutating any history property; preserve the currently recorded incorrect history as correction provenance, and add an exact-original digest checked against the preserved snapshot. Do not rewrite existing raw evidence silently.
findings.reproduction: Canonical sorted compact UTF-8 JSON SHA256 of each prior row differs from recorded oldRowSHA256; adding sourceDefinitionHistory=[] reproduces every recorded digest.
findings.parentVerification: Actual author source read; isolated reproduction and recovery evidence inspected

findings.title: Persisted member loss is accepted by both conservation validators
findings.proof: Both batch variables load the candidate artifact; expected members are looked up in that same batch. Remove the last first-record member and decrement memberCount in an isolated input before script startup: both validators exit 0 and report all ten controls passed. Batch01 loses CMP-worker-core-localRuntime.replayLimit from its upper-bound coordinate; batch02 loses another positiveTimerInteger member. Their in-memory negatives only distinguish clones from the already-loaded candidate.
findings.fix: Derive the required coordinate/member set independently from frozen canonical schema/template/semantic inputs, compare exact IDs including multiplicity, and add persisted-input deletion negatives. Do not use candidate JSON as its own expected baseline.
findings.limit: Current frozen artifacts have not actually lost members: independent ref-graph and ID conservation audits pass. This is a real validator false-positive, not evidence of production runtime weakening.
findings.parentVerification: Actual author source read; isolated reproduction and recovery evidence inspected

findings.title: A valid but unrelated A/B profile link is accepted
findings.proof: Replace first-member completeABProfile/completeAB pointer with /CMP-C1-EFFECT-prism-studio-port in isolated inputs. Batch01 only tests non-null pointer resolution; batch02 does not inspect completeAB at all. Both scripts exit 0 and claim all controls passed although the member is worker-core drainTimeoutMs / prism-control dispatchTimeoutMs respectively.
findings.fix: Require the expected EFFECT case/setting ID and exact profile record binding, verify selected field/config values and current profile identities, and reject cross-owner/cross-field existing profile references.
findings.limit: This demonstrates a traceability integrity gap; independently checked frozen batch02 links are currently correct, and no missing runtime behavior is inferred from these document checks.
findings.parentVerification: Actual author source read; isolated reproduction and recovery evidence inspected
